text:
jena: Quick reminder — final cutoff for v2.4 version bump is in ~6h. Need CI green across release/*, changelog PRs merged, and any branch conflicts resolved. Any blockers?

mohit: On it. Kicking off a focused CI sweep now (smoke + full unit matrix). I’ll post failures.

deploy-bot: CI triggered by @mohit: release/v2.4 -> build #789
```
Trigger: ./scripts/ci/run_matrix --branch release/v2.4 --profile=release
```

lucas: hitting intermittent failure in test_cache_eviction on macOS-latest. Fails ~1/15 runs. Repro on local with stress flags.

qa-sre: Can we label that flaky and auto-rerun just that job for the sweep? Recommended: add @flaky tag + rerun 3x.

mohit: Agree. For now I’ll rerun the failing job and add a transient skip in the test harness with TODO to fix.

carla: Heads-up: there’s a changelog entry missing for the migration step in the kv-store change. If we don’t add it we shouldn’t cut the release. Small paragraph needed under "Migration notes".

jena: @carla can you open the changelog PR? If not, @lucas — can you add the note alongside the test fix? We need the changelog merged before we bump the tag. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lucas: I can do both — will open two tiny PRs: (1) test flaky skip + TODO, (2) changelog block. PRs will reference this thread.

ops-bot: Reminder: branch protection - release/* requires 2 approvals, passing CI, and changelog file updated. Merges blocked until checks pass.

mohit: Current sweep status: 12/14 jobs passed, 2 failed (cache_eviction unit test on macOS, and integration::routed-fallback on linux). Rerunning the two failed jobs.

deploy-bot: Rerun triggered: jobs #789.56 and #789.57.

lucas: rerun fixed the linux integration but mac still flaky. I'll add a focused repro and link to the PR.

carla: opened changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234 — small migration note added. cc @jena @mohit

mohit: Thanks. Holding merges until CI stabilizes. If mac is the only blocker we can do a targeted retry + flaky label and then proceed if no other regressions.

jena: Plan: (1) mark cache_eviction flaky for now and rerun 3x; (2) require changelog PR merged (carla -> done); (3) final tag + version bump once CI is green across non-flaky jobs. If anything else pops, call it out here. Target: cut in 4.5h.

qa-sre: I’ll create an incident card to track the flaky test and assign to lucas for follow-up.

lucas: adding flaky label and test skip in PR now. Will ping when pushed.

mohit: Reruns completed: all green except mac cache_eviction still failing 2/3. Given changelog is merged and only one flaky test remains, I propose we proceed with the bump and create a post-release hotfix if mac users are affected. Thoughts?

jena: Proceed with bump but include mitigation note in release notes and escalate the flaky test to critical for next sprint. +1 from me.

carla: +1. Thanks everyone for the quick sweep. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Release tag prepared: v2.4.0-rc.1 by @mohit (pending final merge).

jena: Great work. I’ll do the final check in ~30m and cut the tag if no regressions. If anyone sees any last-minute fails, drop them here immediately.

mohit: Will monitor and report back.

lucas: PRs posted and links in thread.

qa-sre: Incident card: INF-314 created and assigned.

jena: Thanks all — keeping this thread open until the tag is cut. :white_check_mark:
